case.pattern_description: Unauthorized merchant debit reported by cardholder on secondary card.

evidence.claim: Card C02354-K2 associated with Customer C02354

case.summary: Customer C02354 reported unauthorized $39.08 charge on card C02354-K2. Physical card present with customer while debit occurred from out-of-region IP. Card reissued and chargeback filed.

evidence_requests.assumed_response: Customer confirmed card was in their physical possession when charge occurred online.

initial.reason: R4: Direct customer report of unauthorized charge

final.reason: R7: Dispute opened, card revoked, merchant refund requested

next_best_actions.what_changed: Investigation verified merchant IP address did not match customer's verified billing region.

stop_reason: Policy threshold satisfied: definitive evidence and action determined.
